description: Header file defining SDL utility functions, surface management, and drawing routines for the Wesnoth game project.

classes.name: surface
classes.description: Wrapper class managing SDL_Surface with reference counting and resource management.

classes.name: pixel_data
classes.description: Structure for handling pixel color data and conversions.

classes.name: surface_lock
classes.description: RAII class for locking and unlocking SDL_Surface during pixel access.

classes.name: surface_restorer
classes.description: Class for restoring surface state, possibly during temporary modifications.

classes.name: clip_rect_setter
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily set and restore SDL surface clipping rectangle.

methods.name: sdl_add_ref
methods.description: Increments reference count of SDL_Surface.

methods.name: operator< (const surface& a, const surface& b)
methods.description: Comparison operator for surface objects.

methods.name: make_neutral_surface
methods.description: Creates a neutral (probably transparent or default) surface.

methods.name: create_optimized_surface
methods.description: Creates an optimized version of a surface.

methods.name: scale_surface
methods.description: Scales a surface to specified width and height.

methods.name: scale_surface_blended
methods.description: Scales a surface with blending.

methods.name: adjust_surface_colour
methods.description: Adjusts the color of a surface.

methods.name: greyscale_image
methods.description: Converts a surface to greyscale.

methods.name: brighten_image
methods.description: Brightens a surface.

methods.name: get_surface_portion
methods.description: Extracts a portion of a surface.

methods.name: adjust_surface_alpha
methods.description: Adjusts the alpha transparency of a surface.

methods.name: adjust_surface_alpha_add
methods.description: Adds to the alpha transparency of a surface.

methods.name: mask_surface
methods.description: Applies a mask to a surface.

methods.name: blur_surface
methods.description: Applies a blur effect to a surface.

methods.name: cut_surface
methods.description: Cuts a portion of a surface.

methods.name: blend_surface
methods.description: Blends a surface with a color.

methods.name: flip_surface
methods.description: Flips a surface horizontally.

methods.name: flop_surface
methods.description: Flops a surface vertically.

methods.name: create_compatible_surface
methods.description: Creates a surface compatible with another.

methods.name: fill_rect_alpha
methods.description: Fills a rectangle area with color and alpha transparency.

methods.name: get_non_transperant_portion
methods.description: Gets the non-transparent part of a surface.

methods.name: draw_rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle outline on a surface.

methods.name: draw_solid_tinted_rectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled, tinted rectangle with transparency.
